title: Developer Connector Interface

list_organizations.description: Organizations are addressed by opaque orgref handles, deduplicated and sorted deterministically.
list_organizations.claim_boundary: No provider organization directory is fetched locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

list_resources.description: Resources are listed only within a named organization and only when they declare the required scope.
list_resources.claim_boundary: No provider resource enumeration is performed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

read.description: Read is denied unless the caller holds read and the resource declares read within the requested organization.
read.claim_boundary: No remote resource content is fetched locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

write_when_granted.description: Write is denied unless the caller holds write and the resource declares write; read never implies write.
write_when_granted.claim_boundary: No remote mutation is issued to a provider. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

limits.description: Rate limits are validated (non-negative counts, positive period) and limit checks fail closed on negative or exhausted usage.
limits.claim_boundary: No provider rate-limit header is trusted or parsed locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

health.description: Health reports unavailable, degraded, or ok deterministically from caller-supplied local signals.
health.claim_boundary: Health is computed from local signals, not a live provider probe. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local developer connector interface contract, not a live provider client.
No access token, personal access token, private key, or provider account identifier is stored or returned.
Live organization/resource enumeration, remote reads and writes, and provider rate-limit enforcement remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
